name: Custom Generators
tagline: Build the button. Share the button.

scopeJustifications.ai:write:budgeted: Spends the viewer's Buzz to run the generator's one-tap image generations, capped per generation by the manifest page.buzzBudgetPerGen and gated behind an explicit estimate + Confirm step.
scopeJustifications.buzz:read:self: Reads the viewer's Buzz balance to display it and to block Confirm when a generation's estimated cost exceeds the available balance, offering a top-up instead of a failed spend.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:read: Reads the viewer's own app-scoped drafts so they can resume editing generators they previously saved.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:write: Saves the viewer's own generator drafts to their app-scoped storage so work persists between sessions.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:read: Lists published generators from shared storage to populate the Discover feed that all users browse.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:write: Publishes, updates, and withdraws the viewer's own generators in shared storage so other users can find and run them in Discover.
